review_input.scope: Complete direct UI child decisions distinguish unchanged pinned baseline adoption from real related behavior changes. Product fourteen-flow list/base remains unchanged; no plain/mixed bypass of owned behavior tests.

features.modules: Thin compatible CLI/public facades export prior functions and preserve callback/patch behavior; focused library Python modules are explicit and automatic old/new operational fingerprint inputs.
features.report: Read-only bounded human/compact complete JSON presentations deduplicate impact reasons and actual old/current source/assertion anchors, including coverage groups; selected head/index omit worktree writes. Exact next argv requires substantive notes and actual verification.
features.gaps: Current UI/catalog root schema2 uses163 globally unique stored open-gap IDs with type/severity/layer owner/reason/next verification. Legacy schema1 remains readable without invented metadata. All IDs retained; actual covered portions narrowed, remaining gaps explicit.
features.ui: Successful item actions and relationship changes refresh selected detail/history while preserving independent flags/drafts and rejecting obsolete selected-item responses. Launch/attention modal focus is contained, preserves connected focus across updates, supports Escape and conditional opener restoration; launch errors remain inside dialog.
features.recovery: Assembled daemon tests retain one run after lost Start response/rejected retry and explicitly Resume same run/thread/workspace after dirty refusal while preserving file/history/draft. Independent client races and clean cleanup/history variants remain gaps.
features.pilot_controller: Pure default/native, explicit pilot9224 and literal loopback argument parsing preserve privacy protections and reject unsafe/ambiguous/credential-bearing endpoints without echo. Tests attach no browser and read no profiles.
